blurb: Corbin Mill is a testament to the once thriving mill industry in historic Liberty, MO, one of the oldest towns west of the Mississippi. It was built in 1889 and originally housed a flour mill with land given by a presidential grant for people displaced by the New Madrid Earthquake of the 1800’s .
